lead: The starter party (Bulwark, Duelist, Elementalist) rebuilt from nothing, three ways. Each direction changes body proportions, posture, costume and rendering together, so every hero reads as a working adventurer with a history rather than a jointed figure. All nine went through the art director's review and fixes before this page.

directions.name: Grave-Light
directions.line: Painterly chiaroscuro and tired veterans. The closest to Darkest Dungeon 2, and the strongest read at game size.
specs: Warm key from the upper left, cool fill, soft terminator

heroes.name: The Wall That Stayed
heroes.alt: Direction A Bulwark hunched behind his church-door shield
heroes.pitch: Hunched behind the church door, helm tucked against its edge so only the eye slit shows, mace resting on the rim.
details: Bedroll strapped high on the back
Kill tally scratched into the planks, a broken arrow in the oak
Lead patch riveted over a breach in the breastplate
Rubric strip tied to the ring handle

heroes.name: The Old Bravo
heroes.alt: Direction A Duelist in a low line with a dagger cocked behind
heroes.pitch: A fencing master past his prime: weight back, blade low and forward, parrying dagger cocked behind. Smirking.
details: Grey-streaked queue tied with rubric
Slashed sleeves, stitched old cut across the chest
Half cape with a red lining
Empty scabbard swung back on the hip

heroes.name: The Burnt-Out Scholar
heroes.alt: Direction A Elementalist hunched over an open book with a guttering flame
heroes.pitch: Gaunt and sleepless, hunched over his book, coaxing a guttering flame with six-ink fingers.
details: Six course sigils inked round the hem
Satchel of scrolls on a shoulder strap
Six-sign ring at the rope belt
Linen coif tied under the chin

directions.name: Woodcut Brutes
directions.line: Hard black shadow masses and squat, aggressive bodies. The boldest silhouettes; the furthest from realism.
specs: Hard shadow shapes, almost no mid-tone
Coiled for violence; every pose is mid-action

heroes.name: The Wall
heroes.alt: Direction B Bulwark behind his raised door with the mace cocked back
heroes.pitch: Squared up behind the raised door, mace cocked back over the shoulder, ready to fall.
details: Filthy linen surcoat with an inked key
Rubric strip knotted round the helm
Nail-studded door face, two arrows in it
Gauntlet fingers hooked round the door edge

heroes.name: The Wolf in the Hat
heroes.alt: Direction B Duelist low in a hanging guard under a wide hat
heroes.pitch: Left-handed, low and coiled in a hanging guard, cape wrapped on the off arm as a buckler, grinning under the brim.
details: Wide brim with a crow feather and red band
Bandolier of throwing knives
Coat tails flying back
Lightning scorch on the blade

heroes.name: The Mad Conjoiner
heroes.alt: Direction B Elementalist with arms flung wide and six ink threads between his hands
heroes.pitch: Arms flung wide, coat whipping, shouting the six signs into being between his hands.
details: Six jagged ink threads, one per course
Sigils inked down the lapel
Satchel swinging out on its strap
Wrapped shins and sandals

directions.name: Living Ink
directions.line: The locked manuscript crosshatch, carried onto heavier natural bodies in calm, dignified poses.
specs: Composed and deliberate; menace at rest
The Living Manuscript style and the Codex fiction

heroes.name: The Sentinel
heroes.alt: Direction C Bulwark at rest beside his planted door, hand on the mace pommel
heroes.pitch: At rest and listening, helm bowed, gauntlet on the pommel of the planted mace, the door leaning on his shoulder.
details: Heavy wool mantle with a fur collar
A prayer cut into the door planks
Brass cross riveted to the helm brow
Darned surcoat, dirt rising from the hem

heroes.name: The Widow's Blade
heroes.alt: Direction C Duelist, a woman with arm and blade in one straight line
heroes.pitch: Arm and blade in one straight bar at the enemy's throat, chin up, off hand balancing behind.
details: Mail sleeve on the sword arm only
Braid tied with a rubric strip
Bandaged forearm, knife strapped to the thigh
Capelet and flared jerkin skirt

heroes.name: The Lector
heroes.alt: Direction C Elementalist, a heavy old reader with a scroll unrolling to the ground
heroes.pitch: A heavy old reader walking with a scroll that unrolls to the ground, plucking a sign out of the air.
details: Spectacles and a long white beard
Ink pots hanging from the belt
Worn blue tabard of the six signs
Ink tendrils drifting from pinched fingers

ad_intro: An independent art director agent reviewed all nine figures against the design bible, ranked every problem by severity, then fixed them in the drawing code and re-rendered. Its full critique and fix log are kept with the art source.
ad_fixed: read as socks; rebuilt with heel, arched sole and toe cap, plus knee-high, cavalier and armoured versions.
too small to read; fists now have curled fingers and a wrapping thumb, about 20 percent larger.
read as balls; now plates with a ridge and side wing.
read as headphones; now narrow and set behind the jaw, with shadow under the jaw and brow.
had three hands and stood like a mannequin; now one hand on the pommel, weight on one leg.
the most puppet-like; rebuilt lower with limbs about 35 percent thicker and five costume layers.
a flat red tabard broke the red-only-for-blood-and-rubric rule; now filthy undyed linen.
the sword arm cut across his face; re-posed so the hilt clears the brim.
the ostium badge is now a lead door token on every hero.
ad_open: Faces are better but still simpler than the Darkest Dungeon 2 portraits.
Torsos are built from smooth curves, so chests read soft and robes read as bell shapes.
A Bulwark: the mace haft still passes in front of the bottom edge of the helm.
B Duelist: the block style turns his lower body mostly black.
C Elementalist: the back of the robe below the belt is the plainest area on the roster.
Reaching Darkest Dungeon 2 faces and anatomy would need a painter working over the chosen direction; code-built shapes stop short of it.
questions: Pick a direction for the whole cast, or mix: the recommendation is C's ink rendering on A's proportions and poses, with B's poses kept for attack frames.
Per hero, which version's personality is right? Each can move to another direction's rendering.
Proportion: 6.4 heads (A), 5.8 (B) or 7 (C)? The bible currently says 7.5, which is what made the old cast lanky.
Keep or drop the abbey surcoats on the B and C Bulwarks? The bible says the company's only uniform is the badge and the rubric strip.
C Duelist is a woman, B Duelist is left-handed: keep either as a default or as roster variety?
